coaching.headline: Won the duo lane and nothing else: one tower to ten, first Fangtooth conceded with five alive, zero wards cleared.
coaching.team: We lost this on the map, not in the duo lane. Skylar died three times before minute 10 and Kira finished with 10 kills. Yet the first Fangtooth fell at minute 10 with all five of us alive and nobody contesting, right after we won the fight at 8, 3-2, for nothing. River buffs went 5 to 19, seedlings 0 to 2, and we destroyed zero wards to their six. The fight at 13.3, won 2-0, was cashed into Mini Prime and our only tower. Then the outer-tower defense at 15.9 lost 1-3 and the river fight at 20.5, lost 1-4 but traded into the Fangtooth we took in the same window. The inner-tower fight at 24 opened 4v5 forty seconds after Feng Mao was caught alone. They won eight fights and converted five; we won three and converted one. Next game: the first Fangtooth is never left uncontested with five alive.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The first Fangtooth, conceded at minute 10 with five alive and no contest, set the tempo; the solo catch on Feng Mao at 23.3 decided it. Forty seconds later we fought at our inner tower 4v5, lost 1-4, and two inner towers and an inhibitor followed.
coaching.whatWorked: The duo lane did its job: Skylar died three times before minute 10, six times to Kira overall. The fight at 13.3, won 2-0 by Scarlett and Feng Mao, went straight into Mini Prime.

24.call: Lost before it started: 4v5 at our inner tower, forty seconds after Feng Mao was caught alone, and it ended 1-4 with two inner towers and an inhibitor gone. At four bodies, back off and wait for the fifth.

15.9.call: Hold the tower, do not fight in front of it. Gadget, Feng Mao and Kira died in sequence, the fight went 1-3, two outer towers fell in the next minute, then Fangtooth at 16.8 with all three still dead.

20.5.call: It went 1-4 in open river, four of us dead for one kill, and the Fangtooth we took in the same window is the only thing it bought. A trade, and an expensive one: the call was to group for the Fangtooth without the river fight first.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.build: Soulbinder, Combustion and Tainted Scepter is long-range poke with anti-heal for Mourn; the core of Azure Core, Entropy and Overseer trades that for a shield when hit and self-healing on damage dealt. 10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.eternal: Vesh fits Gadget's zone kit: gate, mines and dome all land ability hits, and Vesh turns each into a damage-over-time, with The Tenth Seal and Mind Rot adding ultimate damage and current-health damage inside the dome.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.build: Malady and Painweaver are the core; Manta Scythe took Omen's slot, trading Omen's cooldown refund and empowered hit for bonus damage on isolated targets. The gap that showed was defensive: no armor at all, and five of the nine deaths were to Serath, Grux and Skylar, the three physical threats.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.eternal: Vermis suits a duelist who wins by sticking to one target through Reaping Dash and Hamstring: every third consecutive hit on the same hero deals max-health damage, and Serration adds missing-health damage right where Earth Shatter's execute finishes.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.build: Maco on Hexbound Bracers, Gaia Greaves and Everbloom without Crescelia, Enra's Blessing or Windcaller; no fight in this game isolates the difference, so nothing to teach here.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.build: Tainted Rounds, Ruination, Imperator and Terminus, without Solaris or Ashbringer. No fight here isolates that gap; the three deaths to Renna land on the team-wide zero magic resist, which this build shares.

threats: Chain-CC risk (2 hard-CC abilities, ~1.0s of lockdown): Mourn Abduct (pull), Grux Crush (knockup 0.5s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Mourn. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 3 items of it.
Dive threat on our backline: Serath. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Gadget Security Gate (root 1s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Maco) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ability.what: Mourn channels to absorb all light from the map for 4s, causing all Enemy Heroes to have massively reduced vision.

loadout.plain: Eclipse gives much more movement speed, so you can cross the map while enemies are blinded and start a fight with Abduct before they react.

loadout.name: Knell
loadout.text: Attacks and abilities against Enemy Heroes apply a stack of Rust for 5s. Each stack shreds 2% (+0.2% per Level) Physical Armor and Magical Armor, stacking up to 4 times. Gain 75% of the Armors shredded.
loadout.plain: Your hits strip the enemy's armor and give you some of it. Contagion hitting several heroes spreads the shred, so your team deals more damage.

loadout.name: Patina
loadout.text: Gain a 30 (+14 per level) Shield when not taking damage for 10s. Gain 4% Movement Speed while the shield holds.
loadout.plain: A shield and a bit of movement speed after a while without damage. Generic safety; nothing special with the kit.

loadout.name: Peal
loadout.text: Gain 15 Ultimate Ability Haste. Upon casting your ultimate, attacks and abilities apply maximum stacks of Rust for 4s. 20s cooldown.
loadout.plain: Eclipse comes back faster, and after casting it your hits apply full armor shred at once, so the fight you start in the dark goes your team's way.

loadout.name: Sanctification
loadout.text: Safeguard:  Grants yourself and nearby Heroes a 150 (+8%) Shield for 3s. While the Shield holds, Heroes gain 50% Tenacity. Visionary:  Gain Solstone. Increase Ward Cap from 2 to 3. Pacifist:  Receive diminishing Gold from Minion kills.
loadout.plain: Shields you and nearby allies and makes crowd control wear off faster. Pop it as you engage with Abduct or Beguile; it also gives an extra ward.

lines: Lead story: Hard to kill. Died 1 time in 30 minutes, fewer deaths than about 94% of Mourn support players this patch. The build added health and armor and healing off damage.
Eclipse at rank 2: 135s base, about 91.2s by the end (32% shorter) from 48 ability haste: Tainted Guard 8, Elafrost 15, Inquisition 10, ultimate haste 15.
Mourn dealt 23,618 hero damage, 18% of their team's, with +0 magical power from items.
Tainted Guard (item): On being hit by a Basic Attack: Reduce the Source's Healing by 45% for 3s. Apply a Bleed dealing 30 (+30%) Damage over 3s.
Fire Blossom (item): Burn nearby Enemy Units: Deals 15 (+1%) Damage each second.Firestorm - When Heatwave damages a Target: Deals 5% more damage each second, up to 40%.
Elafrost (item): On Ability Cast: Empower your next Basic Attack within 4s. Deal 70 (+2%) Damage On-Hit around the Target. Slows by 35% for 1.5s. Damage is increased by 60% against Monsters.
Inquisition (item): On Ability Cast: Emit a wave of energy. Deals 65 (+1.5%) Damage to Enemies in the area. Damage is increased by 45% against Monsters.
Sustain: Sanctification: Grants yourself and nearby Heroes a 150 (+8%) Shield for 3s. While the Shield holds, Heroes gain 50% Tenacity.; 12,686 healing recorded.
Toughness: +1320 health, +150 physical armor, +40 magical armor; took 31,405 damage, mitigated 44,298, died 1 times.

[30 + 14 a level: 254 at level 16] Field: 54.3% in 611 games, 70% of picks, above the hero-role's 52.5%.

(game text: Gain 15 Ultimate Ability Haste. Upon casting your ultimate, attacks and abilities apply maximum stacks of Rust for 4s. 20s cooldown.) Field: 54% in 606 games, 69% of picks, above the hero-role's 52.5%.

(game text: Safeguard:  Grants yourself and nearby Heroes a 150 (+8%) Shield for 3s. While the Shield holds, Heroes gain 50% Tenacity. Visionary:  Gain Solstone. Increase Ward Cap from 2 to 3. Pacifist:  Receive diminishing Gold from Minion kills.) Field: 51.9% in 1392 games, 27% of picks, level the hero-role's 52.5%.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 2 effects on one trigger: Tainted Guard, Elafrost.
Countered? 0 of the 2 players Mourn killed built magical armor. We killed Mourn 1 time.
Copy it? Knell (Patina + Peal): 54% in 411 Mourn support games, above the hero's 52.5%. Proven this patch: worth copying.
